strategy.thesis: Fintech venture builder and investment company that builds and backs businesses across the digital financial services ecosystem — trading platforms, risk management systems, wallet infrastructure and payment technology. Since 2023 it has pivoted toward building an AI financial-intelligence platform (Meridian).

summary.en: Nogle is a Taipei-headquartered fintech venture studio (venture builder) founded in 2014, with an additional office in Singapore. Over ~2014–2023 it built and invested across the fintech/crypto spectrum (trading platforms, risk systems, wallet infrastructure, payments), deploying about US$10M in talent and business growth, and led a US$3M investment in Hong Kong custody firm First Digital Trust. It is now building Meridian, an AI financial-intelligence platform.

strategy.thesis: Mobility-focused venture builder, accelerator and early-stage investor. Does hands-on product development and venture building — co-creating high-end systems with startups and ODMs in electric, autonomous and connected vehicles — while also running acceleration programs and advising corporates on East Asia's mobility ecosystems.

summary.en: Mosaic Venture Lab is a Taiwan-based, mobility-focused venture builder and early-stage venture lab co-founded in 2018. It does hands-on product development and venture building — co-creating high-end systems with startups and ODMs across electric, autonomous and connected vehicles — and also runs acceleration programs and corporate advisory across Taiwan, Japan and Korea. It now acts as a holding company for ventures including CellTech and Tessera.

strategy.thesis: Government-backed (National Development Council) ecosystem organization that in 2019 repositioned itself as a 'Venture Builder' (新創建設家), adopting an 'Asia Venture Studio' advisory model to help Taiwanese startups go global, built around a 'one alliance, one academy' three-year strategy.

summary.en: Taiwan Startup Stadium (TSS), a National Development Council–backed ecosystem body, announced on 22 Feb 2019 that it would reposition as a 'Venture Builder' (新創建設家) using an 'Asia Venture Studio' advisory model, with a three-year 'one alliance, one academy' strategy to strengthen innovation links and help Taiwanese startups go global. It is a public-program venture builder rather than an equity-taking in-house studio.

strategy.thesis: Taipei-based crypto quantitative-trading and market-making firm that has acted as a company builder in Web3 — most notably incubating WOO Network (Wootrade) and its WOO X (CEX) and WOOFi (DEX) products. Its venture arm Kronos Ventures was spun off into independent investment firm Proxima in 2026.

summary.en: Kronos Research is a Taiwan-founded (2018) crypto quantitative-trading and market-making firm that has also functioned as a Web3 company builder, incubating WOO Network (originally Wootrade) in 2019 and its WOO X / WOOFi exchanges. Its dedicated venture arm, Kronos Ventures, was transitioned into an independent investment firm, Proxima, in 2026. Included here for its in-house incubation activity, though its primary business is trading.
